inputs.description: Codex cloud app icon; terminal glyph excluded

prompt: Use case: compositing / logo-brand. Create a completely new premium monochrome brand mark for a personal ChatGPT × Codex workflow plugin. Image 1 is the user's ChatGPT interwoven six-loop emblem, use its continuous interlocking ribbon geometry as the primary identity reference. Image 2 is the actual Codex app icon, use ONLY its soft rounded cloud/petal outer silhouette as the supporting identity reference. REMOVE the >_ terminal glyph entirely. Fuse these two shape languages into ONE coherent, beautifully balanced symbol; it must read as an interwoven ChatGPT knot whose outer lobes gently take on the Codex cloud silhouette, not two logos placed side by side and not one logo pasted on the other. Art direction: refined, editorial, quietly luxurious, flat vector-like precision, consistent substantial ribbon widths, deliberate clean negative space, mathematically calm optical balance, legible at 24px. Palette: white and neutral light grey surfaces with restrained graphite-grey separation/contours where needed for readability, strictly achromatic. No blue, violet, colored fills or saturated accents. One front-facing centered mark occupying approximately 78 percent of a square canvas, with generous equal padding; genuine transparent background. The symbol itself should be predominantly white, not predominantly black. No document, clipboard, checklist, checkmark, terminal window, code brackets, greater-than symbol, underscore, badge, app-tile square, lettering, text, wordmark, watermark, mockup scene, fake checkerboard, metallic bevel, glossy rendering, glow, gradient, or cast shadow. Deliver a single finished standalone icon.
postprocessing: PNG size export only; generated alpha retained
brand_notice: Non-official personal derivative. Brand rights remain with their owners; original reference assets are not redistributed.
